selection_cutover.regression_before: Held departed collector cleanup while injecting 300 real-schema L2 snapshots: unavailable instead of loading
selection_cutover.contract: Initialize at new lease commit; drain new deliveries while joining departed collectors; unchanged queue and native depth bounds

status: Verified and merged through PR #9. Both final-head GitHub gates passed; native live/UI proof and prior failures retained. Plain local live server remains available. The 24-hour soak and execution readiness are not claimed.

native_final_suite.correction: Retain and call the explicitly owned non-optional bootstrap unsubscribe function; focused native, mypy and frontend follow-up in progress

final_offline_browser.skip_reason: Operator-enabled network case is intentionally skipped on offline server.

serialization.contract: Reuse the exact canonical bytes already produced for column output accounting as the incremental hash input; no additional cache or relaxed bounds

live_validation.conclusion: Canonical byte reuse reduces measured redundant work but does not by itself resolve sustained Hyperliquid session overload.

closed_provenance_cache.contract: Encode immutable closed metrics once; charge bytes and overhead to existing 32 MiB history budget; decode fresh query containers; evict/reset/rebuild with sample lifecycle

live_validation.conclusion: Frozen metric caching alone did not eliminate the live byte-bound failure; further owner-path diagnosis required.

before.reason: Held chart query blocked ingestion; both sessions became unavailable from analytical_queue_overflow.

after.assertions: 300 real-schema Hyperliquid snapshots drain to exact quantity301 while the chart query is held; zero overflows; cancellation joins before removal.

combined.additional: Query prefix survives native history eviction; clock cutover rejects presentation commit; cached metric provenance is mutation-isolated and restores from checkpoint.

warnings: StarletteDeprecationWarning: httpx TestClient integration is deprecated; install httpx2 instead.

binance.error: RuntimeError: Native session failed: analytical_queue_overflow: reselect to establish fresh history

component_diagnosis.limitations: A diagnostic sample, not acceptance; timing wrappers add overhead. Earlier Binance overflow remains unresolved.

before.behavior: Actual book delivery could not progress while catalog serialization held the event loop.

after.behavior: Native delivery advances while catalog work is held; metadata, source scope and in-place readiness-reason changes invalidate the catalog response.

measurement.source: Repository's explicit synthetic demo, complete native replay prefix; not live venue data or a throughput guarantee.

final_native_gate.subsequent_failure: Ruff F401: obsolete api.dto import after catalog conversion moved to the runtime worker.

import_cleanup.removed: Unused api.dto import and the regression hook for that obsolete binding; the held-conversion regression patches the actual runtime DTO entrypoint.

intermediate_check.failure: Regression still patched removed api.dto; obsolete patch removed, not restored as an alias.

contrast_before.note: Quantity comparisons are display diagnostics over actual retained SOL cells, not financial calculations.

network_browser_before_contrast.command: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run test:e2e -- e2e/source-experience.spec.ts

network_markup_failure.cause: The test required an explicit option value attribute, but valid option values came from text. Removed that incidental markup assertion; actual option selection and viewport recovery remain exercised.

contrast_after.note: Trusted slider keyboard input, waited for the existing 200ms preference write, then real reload. Scale stays fixed until another explicit user change; no market-data normalization changed.

post_contrast_browser_attempt.cause: One manually created browser context used hardcoded port8000, ignoring the isolated offline baseURL on8002 and reaching the persistent live service. Its replay controls were correctly disabled.
post_contrast_browser_attempt.fix: Use the configured Playwright context fixture and relative URLs; preserve the independent-session and close-one-owner behavior checks.

export default { ...config, use: { ...config.use, baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:8002' } };

github_ci_fixture_race.cause: The fixture startup transaction and manual injection could concurrently own the same source decoder/reducer. The departed-close barrier did not establish completion of the selected source initial epoch/snapshot.
github_ci_fixture_race.fix: Wait for the first completed native transaction before sequential manual injection. Keep all 300 updates, held old-source cleanup, exact quantity, cancellation and overflow assertions; no production changes.
